Name: Eldritch Furniture
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[b]"There are things much older. Older than time. And they blessed me."[/b]

The Eldritch Furniture Pack brings 70+ pieces of dark, cosmic horror-themed furniture to Stardew Valley — from tentacle-wrapped bookshelves and skull-adorned fountains to glowing void portals and a butler who probably knows too much.

Decorate your home with fully animated items including cauldrons that bubble with unknown substances, crystals that pulse with eldritch energy, rugs that open into the earth itself, and candles that burn in colors no flame should. Hang paintings of places you've never been but somehow remember. Let the Cursed Wardrobe breathe. Whether you're building a dark sanctum, a forbidden library, or simply tired of the same old country cottage aesthetic — the void has exactly what you're looking for.

It was always there. You just couldn't see it yet. Let it in.

If you like the mod, please consider giving it an endorsement. It helps more people succumb to the void.
